title: Agents can use the GIF workspace - the connector's GIF surface
description: Under umbrella MPI-757. The connector, the in-app agent and the cubric-vision skills carry ZERO GIF surface; only raw undocumented HTTP routes exist. Add POST /connector/gif/{make,edit,cutout,to-video} over the renderer job channel (the renderer owns itemGroups, so a server-side project.json write is overwritten on the next save; and the cut-out's engine dispatch is renderer-side). Fabio 2026-09-19: connector FIRST, the in-app agent's tools are the in-app agent session's job. v1 drops By colour, SAM3 object chips, the brush and per-frame scope.
